# Human Super Intelligence (HSI)

> Evidence-linked health and immunology research technology: biological context, source-linked evidence, and independent human review. For research and education — not a clinical decision system and not a substitute for qualified professional care.

Canonical site: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/
Sitemap: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/robots.txt

## Public marketing pages

- [Home](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/): Shared research foundation overview
- [Platform](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/platform): Research intelligence platform and product boundaries
- [Technology](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/technology): Knowledge graph and research technology
- [Science](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/science): Educational human biology and evidence explorer
- [Research](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/research): Evidence-linked research workbench overview
- [Products](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/products): Ecosystem products and maturity labels
- [Solutions](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/solutions): Translational and discovery workflows
- [Evidence & safety](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/evidence-safety): Provenance, uncertainty, human review
- [How it works](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/how-it-works): Question to research brief
- [Access options](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/pricing): Research access and pilots
- [Research access](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/contact): Request account / access

## Ecosystem products (separate experiences)

- [Aksh Health](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/for-aksh): Personal health context product (separate care setting and data)
- [Immune Super Intelligence (ISI)](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/for-isi): Immune-science research product
- [HSI Trials](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/for-trials): Planned trials research programme (no live matching or enrolment)

## Honesty / non-goals

- No live clinical decision support (CDS) and no patient PHI in the HSI substrate
- Gate C / scientific promotion to product knowledge graphs remains human-gated
- Account signup does not grant research write or reviewer permissions
- APIs under `/api/` and internal `/_pages/` HTML are not public discovery surfaces
